WITH
    (SELECT max(DateKey) FROM retail.FactOnlineSales) AS snapshot_date,
    customer_metrics AS
    (
        SELECT
            CustomerKey,
            max(DateKey) AS last_purchase_date,
            dateDiff('day', max(DateKey), snapshot_date) AS recency_days,
            sum(SalesAmount - ReturnAmount - DiscountAmount) AS total_spend,
            countDistinct(ProductKey) AS product_variety
        FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
        GROUP BY CustomerKey
    )
SELECT
    segment,
    count() AS customer_count,
    avg(total_spend) AS avg_spend,
    avg(product_variety) AS avg_product_variety
FROM
(
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        total_spend,
        product_variety,
        multiIf(
            recency_days <= 90, 'Active',
            recency_days <= 180, 'At Risk',
            'Churned'
        ) AS segment
    FROM customer_metrics
)
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY
    multiIf(segment = 'Active', 1, segment = 'At Risk', 2, 3)
